name: Launch codes probe (in-game test)
description: In-game test only (tests/in-game/launch-codes.json), never shipped: level 11's launch code count (difficulty_codes.c). The count's call goes to the stub; the stub gives the Launch Codes their key and every other carrier a zero key; in a mission the game's own count (0x9B9820) over the live carriers equals the Launch Codes' share, not every carrier's. One PROBE line per check.
